column1: Clause  2  :  This  clause  introduces  a  new  section  18A  immediately  after  section  18  of  the
Civil  Aviation  Act,  No.  14  of  2010  and  the  legal  effect  of  the  amendment  is  to  make
touting  for  passengers  within  the  premises  of  the  aerodrome  an  offence  and  to  prescribe
for  the  procedure  in  case  such  an  offence  is  committed.
